name: When is the best time to start using a Florida Living Guide for relocation planning?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to start using a Florida Living Guide for relocation planning?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is advisable to start utilizing a Florida Living Guide early in your relocation planning process, ideally 6-12 months before your intended move. This timeframe allows ample opportunity to research different communities, understand market trends, and refine your preferences. Starting early also gives you time to understand the nuances of specific areas within our service regions, like the seasonal variations in South Florida's real estate market, which can affect home availability and pricing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Begin using a Florida Living Guide 6-12 months before your move to research communities and understand market trends, including seasonal variations.
